Publication statement: Philadelphia; Printed and sold by R. Aitken [1776]

Relief shown pictorially. Shows the Maritime Provinces, Newfoundland, and the St. Laurence River Valley between 1755 and 1757. Inscribed to "His Majesty's Province of Nova Scotia ... " Includes "View of Boston," inset of Halifax Harbor, and insets, with indexes, of Halifax, Quebec, and "City & port of Louisbourg." Scale ca. 1:3,750,000.
